brief: The owner, 2026-11-28, verbatim, about the findings of a code audit of the server as it stood: "If any happen to be code that we are removing, then let's ignore them. But if there are any that point out things that will be staying, like our engine, then we need to address those." Then, on being given the recommendations: "Approve the recommendations."
entry: Audit findings in code the rebuild removes are ignored. Every finding in code that stays, the engine included, is addressed, as the approved recommendations place and order them (storage first, then jobs and cleanup, reading film files, subtitles and pictures; database items when the new database is designed). The recommendations are kept by the lead outside this public repository and go to the product owner when planning starts.
